msg: There will always be a pair of gnomes, and there are 4 pairs that always appear together: red and yellow, pink and green, blue and purple, and, orange and brown.The red, blue, green and orange gnomes always lead to a bright forest.The yellow, pink, purple and brown gnomes always lwad to a dark forest.Remember which gnomes lead to which forest. Only the colour of gnomes matter, not size, postion etc. The amount of mushrooms in each forest changes, but it seems to go in trends of which forest gives more. If the colour forest you have been choosing seems to produce a low amount of mushrooms, try the other forest to test if their amount is also low or if that forest is now producing more.
